class.name: BehaviorTreeReactiveSelector
class.brief_description: Priority selector that reevaluates higher-priority tasks every tick.
class.description: Runs children from index zero every time the [BehaviorTreeRunner] ticks. The first child that succeeds or is running wins. A newly available higher-priority child can interrupt a lower-priority running branch, and the interrupted branch's runner-local execution state is cleared. The selector fails if all children fail. The selector respects the [BehaviorTreeRunner] terminal state: a runner that finished requires [method BehaviorTreeRunner.reset] before it can run again. Preemption does not roll back blackboard writes or notify custom tasks.
